collection.title: Mitsubishi Shogun Sport 1996 to 2008 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mitsubishi Shogun 1996 - 2008 requires a 20" wiper blade for both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. There is also the option to upgrade to the Retrofit style wiper.
